description: Paint a rainbow with Robo and learn the colours of the rainbow in order! A rainbow paints itself across the sky, then Robo's magic paintbrush paints it again one stripe at a time: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple. Say each colour, find something that colour (a red apple, an orange, a yellow banana, a green frog, a blue birdie and a purple butterfly) with a 3, 2, 1 choice, and fill up the rainbow tracker. The last stripe is a surprise colour, then a quick point-to-it quiz and the rainbow song all together.

youtube.description:
Paint a rainbow with Robo and learn the colours of the rainbow in order! A rainbow paints itself across the sky, then Robo's magic paintbrush paints it again one stripe at a time: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple. Say each colour, find something that colour (a red apple, an orange, a yellow banana, a green frog, a blue birdie and a purple butterfly) with a 3, 2, 1 choice, and fill up the rainbow tracker. The last stripe is a surprise colour, then a quick point-to-it quiz and the rainbow song all together.

Colours in rainbow order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple. A rainbow has seven colours (indigo and violet after blue); for toddlers we sing six and call the last stripe purple.

Sing at home: point to something red in your room, then orange, yellow, green, blue and purple, and sing the colours in order. Draw a rainbow together one stripe at a time and name each colour. The Rainbow Colours Song has original lyrics and an original tune written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
